governingIdea: The collection is a plate book. Each Atelier composition is a catalogue plate — the supplied studio render with its rectangle dissolved so the car stands in a pool of light on the page's own ground — and the colour facts are its record, set as a hairline plate rather than as marketing copy. The page is read as a set of two entries, not as two campaign frames.

a1.eventStatement: A Purosangue in the collection's lead Atelier composition stands lit on the page's ground while the collection names itself, lists its two entries and offers the one action the visitor came for.

components.function: the authored ground the masses stand in — a top-down darkening plus the spill of the light the car stands in
the vehicle, at the scale its source composition gives it, uncropped
the American Grand Tour badge and the collection's name
the collection's own contents — the two compositions, named and numbered
the enquiry, placed in the air the car's nose opens

excluded.why: persistent chrome — the retailer masthead is the frame, not part of the event

commitments.why: U6 — no horizontal page scroll at any width
a two-entry collection is a short book, not a scroll

operations.governs: the presentation of every exterior: an elliptical mask derived from the car's measured bounding box (x 0.162-0.761, y 0.228-0.835 of the 16:9 frame) reaches zero at the frame's four edges and stays opaque past every extreme point of the silhouette, so the studio rectangle dissolves and the car stands on the page uncropped
the plate carries its own field, so no layer edge is ever hidden only by the ground beneath it
interiors keep a rectangular frame while exteriors dissolve — two image treatments, one stated rule: an exterior is an object on a floor, an interior is a view
the page alternates axis rather than centring — manifesto right, heritage headline left, entry 01 image-left, entry 02 record-left

entry 01 is read image-first with its record hung off the car's shoulder; entry 02 is read record-first on the mirrored axis with a smaller exterior held high and the interior descending from the left bleed
every colour fact is a hairline spec plate with a subordinate key column, never a box, a card or a caption
Rosso appears in exactly one interface role, the primary control fill; the red of the marque reaches the page through the car itself
the masthead keeps a scrim while it is still travelling over the cover and takes an opaque ground only once its bottom edge has cleared the cover's
the mobile plate's width and offset are computed from the car's own centre so the subject is centred and whole at 390 and at 320 — not inherited from the desktop crop

hero.subjectBoxSource: measured on img/road-mountain-pass-ext-2000.webp by thresholding chroma and dark trim against the neutral studio ground; columns and rows agree to within 2px across three thresholds

means.name: primary enquiry action, above the fold
collection index — a route to each composition

build.kind: retailer preview — standalone page, Cauley Ferrari masthead reproduced
